rationale: The article analyses transboundary river basin governance, the Mekong River Commission, and regional-national decision-making between international donors and member states in the Lower Mekong Basin. It does not examine household or community domestic water supply or sanitation service access (E07) or any service-access outcome.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings because the article examines transboundary river basin governance and international relations in the Lower Mekong Basin rather than household or community domestic water or sanitation service access (E07).

evidence_quotes.quote: Scalar Disconnect: The Logic of Transboundary Water Governance in the Mekong
This article provides an institutional analysis of the Mekong River Commission
obscure potential conflict/tension in transboundary water governance in the Mekong.
